vexillātĭo ,
			ōnis, f.
		id.. 
I.
			A body of the vexillarii; acc. to others, a body of soldiers united under one flag
			(vexillum), a corps, battalion, Suet. Galb. 20;
					Inscr. Orell. 845;
			2009 sq. al.—
        
II.
			A division of cavalry, a
			troop, squadron,
				Veg. Mil. 2, 1;
				Amm. 25, 1, 9;
				App. M. 7, p. 191, 3.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
